parameters.name: AclAction
parameters.description:
The action that is performed on traffic that hits the DNS firewall policy. Valid values:

- **accept**: allows the traffic.

- **drop**: denies the traffic.

- **log**: monitors the traffic.

> If you do not specify this parameter, policies of all action types are queried.

parameters.name: AclUuid
parameters.description: The unique ID of the firewall rule.

parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number to return. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The description of the DNS firewall policy.

parameters.name: Destination
parameters.description:
The destination address in the DNS firewall policy. Fuzzy match is supported.

> The value of Destination can be a CIDR block, a domain name, or an address book.

parameters.name: IpVersion
parameters.description:
The IP version that is supported. Valid values:

- **4**: IPv4

- **6**: IPv6

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description: The language of the response messages. Valid values: **zh** (Chinese) and **en** (English).

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page.

parameters.name: Release
parameters.description:
The status of the access control policy. The policy is enabled by default after it is created. Valid values:

- **true**: enables the access control policy.

- **false**: disables the access control policy.

parameters.name: Source
parameters.description:
The source address in the DNS firewall policy. Fuzzy match is supported.

> The value of Source can be a CIDR block or an address book.

parameters.name: SourceIp
parameters.description: The source IP address of the request.
